fieldValues.title: Working groups cost more routines than we can keep running
fieldValues.statement: I want each working group to keep moving with little upkeep. Today each group needs its own builder, reviewer, steward and analyst cloud routines, and the number we can run is limited. We keep losing them: disabled, still on old prompts, or drifted from their records. When one is lost, the group stops quietly.
source_ref: clerk routines --check, 2026-10-27: 16 blocking drifts; SRS Bug Fixer and Branch Auditor disabled; editor builder and reviewer every 4h
